# Beyond Style UAE

> Elegant fashion accessories and gift-ready pieces, delivered across the United Arab Emirates. Stainless-steel bracelets with gold-tone and silver-tone finishes, Arabic-calligraphy pieces, hamsa and evil-eye charms. Cash on delivery and card payment. Fast WhatsApp ordering.

Beyond Style UAE is an online accessories boutique operated by Beyond Connect General Trading L.L.C (Dubai Trade License No. 1498624). The storefront is bilingual (Arabic and English) and built mobile-first as an installable progressive web app.

## Key facts
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Ships nationwide.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (COD) and card (Stripe Checkout).
- Delivery: Free within Dubai for orders above AED 200; other emirates charged by area.
- Currency: AED (United Arab Emirates Dirham).
- Product wording is descriptive and compliant: finishes are called "gold-tone" and "silver-tone" (not solid gold).
- Ordering channels: website checkout and WhatsApp.
